plugins.description: Give an AI a specific, measurable personality. The bundled skill guides the whole workflow: turn a character into HEXACO traits, start from a gallery persona or author one, compile it to chat/social/voice/npc/robot with npx personalaity, deliver a working kit, and measure adherence and sycophancy.
